name: Toumei Ningen THE GAME
source:
One day, the main character picks up a medicine bottle full of pills. When he takes it, he becomes invisible! He immediately goes to a public bath.... After that, he goes to a girls' high school....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
有一天，主角拿起一个装满药丸的药瓶。当他拿起它时，他就会变得隐形！他立即去了公共浴室……然后，他去了女子高中……

[来自工口游戏商店]
